name: holvi-agent-bridge-extension
description: Chrome extension tooling for Holvi Agent Bridge.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist/extension && tsgo -p tsconfig.extension.json && bun build src/extension/background.ts --target browser --format iife --outfile dist/extension/background.js && rm dist/extension/policy.js dist/extension/projections.js && cp src/extension/manifest.json dist/extension/manifest.json
scripts.sync:artifacts: bun run build && cp dist/extension/background.js dist/extension/config.js dist/extension/content.js dist/extension/manifest.json assets/extension/
